notes.title: 2.1-1 Update!
notes.content:
Okay, So this is an Update that has been a Long Time in the making.

I want to firstly say, Thank you to all of you that has been sticking around from the Start.

Please also be aware This is a - 1 Majoyr Patch and Includes an Overhaul of features and Re-Implements old features and Adds Many more features.

Lets get down to the Main feature that has been teased the Most.

[h1]UI V2 Overhaul[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160850/e62b8cb88e01ac534ca03d9c0284e61586786b3e.png[/img]
Okay so this is a long time in the making.

Alot of you have already known and complained about the over simplified and somewhat confusing UI/GUI. This overhaul is designed to be Modular and easy to use for both New and Experianced players.

This overhaul also preps the UI for future Customisation content in the long run.

So whats new with the new UI?
[list]
[*] Overall quality.
[*] More buttons have been given a "Hover" and "Un-Hover" Animations.
[*] Icon Buttons received an overall quality update.
[*] Text and Icons size has been Increased.
[*] Main Page shows Current Session.
[*] Main Page Shows Local User Icon, Name and Money.
[*] Main Page only includes "Friends Online" Quick Menu instead of multiple.
[*] Main Page only shows Buttons to: "Locations", "Social", "Inventory" and "Mods" (Mod Support not Available yet).
[*] Main Page now includes a Mini-Media Player.
[*] In Game weather moved from "Map" to the Main Page.
[*] Maps was Removed
[*] Player Buttons in Socials has been updated to the New design.
[*] Messages Button has beend added (This does not do anything until complete, but is ready for when it is).
[*] Settings UI overhaul.
[*] Settings Changes moved from Drop down to "Next" and "Previous" (This makes it easier to use on Both Desktop and VR).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160850/fb0d1b7dd3694841dc04e3e98b060300f521a1b3.png[/img]
[*] Shops UI's Have been overhauled to feel more like a Shop
[*] Shops now Contain individual Images based on the current shop.
[*] Shops UI Reduced to 1 to imrpove on UI CPU load.

[*] Added A Furniture store for player housing.
[*] Notifications are now Bottome Middle of the Player UI.
[*] Additional UI Optimisation to reduce CPU Usage.
[*] Translations for "English", "French" and "Japanese" has been added (Will set based on default value of your PC).
[/list]

[h1]Laser-Tag Re-Implementations[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160850/b393459cc19db91a8d34932db23fe5dc5b0ef484.jpg[/img]

Ok, So a lot of you may or may not have been around during the last time Laser-Tag was added to Razgovor Online then unfortunatly was removed due to too many issues.

This removal was until I had re-Worked it and made sure the Mini-Game is Play-Test or EA ready.

Well I am happy to announce, Laser-Tag is back and better than before!

[list]
[*] Readded Laser-Tag Back into Razgovor Online
[*] Laser-Tags Starting Location is now a Reception(For people who are waiting to play to relax).
[*] Moved from Level Streaming to Instanced Level. (Due to Crashes and to avoid Anti-Social behavour).
[*] 3D Laser-Tag Menu (For VR Support but is also usable in Desktop).
[*] Team Selection is now possible.
[*] Restarting A Match will no longer require for you to restart the game mode instance.
[*] Steam Leaderbaord.
[/list]

[h1]Housing and Furniture System V1[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160850/2a8ff7ce52df36a0012230dade872f4041ca73b6.png[/img]

So, This was never on the Roadmap for 2.1, but for a 2.1.x patch. 

Instead of going from a Main Menu the game now puts you in an Apartment. Along with that, it may seem empty on Join and thats by design as that leas us into the next part.

[h3]Furniture System V1[/h3]
Furniture System V1 is the first version of the Furniture system, which allows the Host/Owner of an Apartment/House/Land to place furniture Wherever and however they want.

You create the home you want to live in.

Aditionally, There is now a Video player for Players to use (only uses Youtube Video Links (Streams WIP)).

Full Guide bellow: 
[previewyoutube=ep5C0l0eXB8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1] VR Support [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160850/4bf14b8e7c24752d1ff01ce7956ac2b57d324639.jpg[/img]
Ok now heres an interesting one. This has never been a plan but VR has been officially added.

Supported VR:
[list]
[*] HTC Vive (Full Support).
[*] HTC Vive Index (Partial Support(Finger Tracking not Available until 2.1-2)).
[*] Microsfot Mixed Reality. (Full Support)
[*] Quest 1-3 PCVR (Partial Support(Finger Tracking not Available until 2.1-2)).
[/list]

Pico Vision on PCVR is planned to have support later down the line.
Still no Quest Support. (For now).

[h1]Host Migration System (HMS)[/h1]

Ok, So. Staying online in any Social Game, Espetially one that is Open world and Always online needs to be able to play the game and not be taken away from the gameplay at any given time.

As a lot of you know, Razgovor Online does not yet have Servers and uses Peer 2 Peer Connections.

Unfortunatly this has the issue with this method is that when the Host leaves, all Clients will be sent to the Login Screen.

To Prevent this Razgovor Online has implemented Host Migration System (HMS).

HMS is a Plugin which Razgovor relise on to keep all the players connected no matter what.

This is Razgovor Online's Temporary soultion before servers as a way to keep the game percistant and active!

notes.title: Monthly Report - March
notes.content:
Hello all! Its has been another month of Development and BETA testing for the Play-Test.

A lot has been worked on since last report, Hens why this report is a little bit late.
Lets get right to it!.

[h2]Razgovor Onlines Open world Map[/h2]

Thats right, finally an open world to explore after so long, One of Razgovor's biggest Road blocks (Not pun intended), is finally over.

Now with the Open world map Razgovor's vehicles have a purpose.

This now means you can either travel to the new location by Foot, By Car, Or By Bus (Teleport travel which costs in-game money).

[h2]Delivery Job system V.2 is complete![/h2]

After some time, implementing Delivery V1 was as simple as go and pickup a job and go-to the next location, Now You go-to the pickup location, pickup you'r job and can visually see the job you're doing.

Delivery Job V.2 also has support for VR and Desktop.

[h3]Showing off Delivery Job V.2 in Desktop and in VR[/h3]
[previewyoutube=zN37e__eg6s;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=h0i6xfbIOYA;full][/previewyoutube]
(Please be aware the low frame count is due to the video being done in Editor as the full release is significently better).

Delivery Jobs will indicate to new and existing players about the Bus Stop locations and drop off locations!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160850/528fab6c6eb2ed75fe9a93b71f8033f3b15c1836.png[/img]

[h2]Temporary Player housing is complete![/h2]

As a lot of you already know, Razgovor starts in a Menu format which worked at the time, but due to upcoming changes to the game i.e. Player Housing V.1 in Patch 2.2 and VR Supporting coming in 2.1 I have made the decision to move away from the Menu to a new Home spawn. 
Taking notes from other Social online games.

[h3]Player Hosuing comes with a fully furnished and with a working video player[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160850/2a8ff7ce52df36a0012230dade872f4041ca73b6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160850/769ea7070e08025942eff70183d3214d7bbf0c7d.png[/img]

[h2]VR and Desktop Support[/h2]

Tests have been done and the full intergration of VR has been added for Half body, This system also replicates which means anyone can see if you're in VR or Desktop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160850/4bf14b8e7c24752d1ff01ce7956ac2b57d324639.jpg[/img]

[h2]Replication and Info sharing to each client[/h2]

So some of you already know, Razgovor has always had problems implementing sharing info to other players via the Social Profile.

Changing how info is being shared, I have got the info to work and will be finalizing it with the info you need from each user profile!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160850/f38e2ceb38b1a9b3e1bc6565ab3c549b77b2ca0c.png[/img]

[h1]Laser Tag Re-implementation[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160850/683bd289a243e1ec07d949310549206aa9aed10e.png[/img]
(Laser Tag Reception Room)

Ok, as you can see, this one is a larger font.
If you're new to Razgovor Online this is new for you.

But to those who have been around since 2.0.0 this is some news for you!

Laser Tag has been re-added back to Razgovor Online and fixes a lot of problems that plagued the Mini-Game for some time.

Laser's have been fixed and will always shoot to the center of your screen (Desktop) and VR is where you aim.

The Upcoming BETA Test for Laser Tag will be next week!

[h2]Final Notes[/h2]

Okay, so the Development of 2.1 has been a long one, with the main focus being around getting most of the old and new systems in.

Focusing on Re-Adding Laser Tag (If successful will pave the way for future Mini-Games).

With the next BETA closing in, 2.1 is looking at a possible 2025 Release!

Also, as Razgovor Online 2.1 is getting close the Play-Test has been put on hold until 2.1 is out.

Once Laser Tag and the UI is done, All that remains is finalising the player customisation and Re-Adding Emotes for Desktop.

And then it will be 3D Modeling from there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160850/d8ffd588ffb464e7dbc917570f73dd52cae145af.png[/img]

You can follow the Development by joining the [url=https://trello.com/b/KFq6Wrnb/razgovor-online-roadmap]Roadmap[/url] or Even join the Official Discord!

Hope to see you all for the 2.1 Patch!

notes.title: Monthly Report - February
notes.content:
[h1]New Upcoming features and features being pushed forward[/h1]

Februrary has been an eventful month for Razgovor Online's Development, adding more features that was planned for future updates.

This desicion was made as I fel that now would be the best time to add said features.

[h2]Vehicle's V1 Progress[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160850/0fbca98604d39154554138f523809d2ac14a955f.png[/img]
A lot of progress has been made for vehicles. Thanks to a recent BETA test with the community I was able to fix a few issues preventing players from being able to flip the cars on there heads.

In terms of Vehicle movement, I plan on making the driving feel more Arcade in driving style.

[h3]Vehicle Full Usability Demonstration[/h3]

[previewyoutube=fB0o3VNmKmo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]VR Support[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160850/8ef19b0e580b2eb988e58b5124c6fe58ce403df5.png[/img]
Okay, so this one is an interesting topic to bring up.

For a while the idea of VR Support has been floating around.
With the intergration of MimicPro (VR Intergration Plugin).

Razgovor Online will be supporting official VR Support.

[h3]Supported VR:[/h3]
[list]
[*] HTC Vive.
[*] Microsoft Mixed Reality.
[*] Index.
[*] Quest (PCVR not Standalone)
[/list]
Please be aware that there will be no support for Standalone Quest and the visuals of Razgovor Online will NOT be altered for VR Support.

This will mean Lower End PC's are not supported for VR Support and will require a 1660 or better.

[h2]Delivery System V1[/h2]

All of Delivery System V1's Animations have been added and all working based on which delivery you have chosen.

Pickup Locations are not yet added.

[h2]Bonsila Town Re-Added[/h2]

Bonsila Town has been Re-Added to UE5.4 with aditional Optimisation allowing the Town to run at 145fps.

[h2]Dynamic Store System and UI Updates[/h2]
The First version of Dynamic store has been fully intergrated and has been Tested for Cybergenesis.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160850/751af7978c61d5359f9793a83a937e22315abdb1.png[/img]

Alterations to the Player Profile UI and Level Systems now have Icons.
The new Player profile shows you what location you or others are in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160850/c864b0fe9e0f12ad174e08ee7f42df810c74fd90.png[/img]

[h2]Video Player And Audio Link[/h2]
Another feature the was planned for future updates has been added in the recent BETA.

Firstly, Razgovor Online will be getting a Youtube Video player which will allow Players to play video's or DJ at different locations, which will be used for Housing, Bars Clubs and an more.

This also includes the adition of Audio Link, Which allows lights and other effects to work with the Audio being provided by the Video players adding a little bit of depth to each location.

[previewyoutube=OgzrS__mofE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Preview at The Vault Underground[/h2]

Thank you for your patients, the 2.1 Patch is a big patch and I want to make sure it shows on the final build.

If you have any Questions or Concerns feel free to join the official [url=https://discord.com/invite/J6FUuZ7f8g]Discord[/url] for more news and updates!

notes.content:
Hello all, as promised, here is another Monthly Report.

This Monthly Report is early as I will be taking 2 Weeks off development (At least try to).

[h1]HNTI Victoria Updates[/h1]

As you already know from the previous Monthly Report, I have started to Re-Work buildings using the Building V2 modeling.

For some time, HNTI Victoria has been in the planning faze of Re-working as the building needed a complete overhaul.

Currently the Shopping Center does its job at providing a Social Area and 2 Key features.
[olist]
[*] Shops
[*] Delivery Drop Off Points.
[/olist]

The Overhaul will provide a much more detailed Exterior and Interior whilst also providing an aditional peformance increase.

[h3]Current HNTI Victoria[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160850/128db1c0377dac8ba80da88054e606cfe64854fc.png[/img]

As I have stated before, I have moved Razgovor Online to Unreal Engine 5.4 to use new features to improve on the gameplay.

One key feature being implimented in "Motion Matching" Which allows for Smoother and Less snappy animations.

This allows the game to feel less cheap when it comes to player Movement.

Along with adding Motion Matching, I have implimented the first version of Delivery V.2's Delivery Animations.
So when you pick up a Job you will be holding items instead of just walking back an forth, allowing the Delivery Jobs and any job in the future to feel more dynamic.

One of the 2 Upcoming outfit sets have been added into Razgovor Already.

notes.title: Monthly Report - November
notes.content:
Welcome to the Monthly Report on the current Development of Razgovor Online.

This is to allow for you as the community to see what the current progress of the game is, This being 2.1 progress.

Razgovor Online 2.1 is a Major patch and will be taking its time to Develop.

[h3]Engine Changes[/h3]
Razgovor Online is moving away from Unreal Engine 5.0 to UE 5.4. This is to allow for optimisations and certain features to be fixed as they have been engine bugs.

such as: D3D Crashing.

[h1]UI/GUI Overhaul[/h1]

[h3]New Home Menu[/h3]
I have been spending some time in Re-Working the UI/GUI to be a much easier experiance to use.
The current progress is the new Home menu (To allow for users to be able to navigate the UI easily and have the option to use the "Quick Access" menu).

The new Menu will also show Updates and upcoming events, Along with the In Game weather, making it easier for roleplayers to know the current weather without needing to Navigate seperate menu's.

The Quick Access will show things such as, Online(In game) friends, and a Quick Wardrobe to allow for you to switch into your favourate outfits without needing to navigate the Inventory.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160850/2ce0d8e0bfac67c8b2e5ca2cabca7955c33c6038.png[/img]

[h3]Player Profile[/h3]

Some changes have been made to the user profile, The new UI uses more spaces to allow for the menu to feel less empty.

The new profile will show your Name, Leve and Rank. 

The current progress of the new UI changes to the profile also shows the new Level Tracker with the new upcoming Leveling system coming to Razgovor Online (Not yet implemented).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160850/ff6a9913e11a2daf4efcb59d25bfc5a288850b37.png[/img]

[h3]Navigation Bar[/h3]

As some of you may know, the Current Navigation bar shows only Icons to Menus they need to go-to, With the new Home Menu implimentations, some changes needed to be made to the Nav Bar.

Due to complaints on how difficult the previous Nav bar was to Navigate (Finding Certain tabs and the Player Profile). These changes have been made to keep things clear and easy to understand.

I have moved the Player currancy to the Navbar to use up less space on the player HUD.

[h1]Animation and Locomotion[/h1]

Some changes have been made in regards to the players Head movement in First person as the game is focusing more on being a First person game.

The new changes will remove the "Headbobbing" camera and will be a toggle option for those who prefer Headbobing over Not having Headbobing.

[h1]Online Multiplayer[/h1]

[h3]Host Migration V.1[/h3]
The first implimentation of Host migration has been added to Razgovor and is being heavily worked on to allow for Host Migration in 2.1.

[h3]Character Replication[/h3]
I have been making some Optimisation on the current Replication system and also made some changes on how some features work (Such as Running).
Meaning Sprinting will no longer lag as it will run Locally and on the Server (In case of server lag/stutters).

[h1]Enviroment Changes[/h1]

[h3]housing V.2[/h3]
Current Changes on housing has gone through and has passed tests.

These changes allows for faster development time on buildings, but also allows for more details to go into the each building.

Granted these buildings aren't amazing by a long shot, but is still a great way to show off the enviroment you are in without feeling plain or basic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160850/3ee724a6831e8a7befb934b21fcef43fab457bd4.png[/img]

[h1]Vehicles V.1[/h1]

The first implimentation of Vehicles have been added to Razgovor and will be recieving extensive work for 2.1.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160850/d8546ef3cec23a902590f711e38aadb019ec12b1.png[/img]
